# icedtea

> Native desktop widgets and chrome for iced. Constructors return
> Elements and emit the application's messages.

Your program owns the data. One Action table feeds menus, toolbars,
shortcuts, and the command palette. Call a constructor for a job.
Start from `examples/hello.rs`.

This file is generated from `catalog::ENTRIES` and constructor
rustdoc. Run `just agents-doc` after those change.

## Compose

- [First window](examples/hello.rs): `run!`, `Boot`, `ActionTable`,
  `seed_quit`, `From<keyboard::Event>`, `key::handle`, `focus::cycle`
- [Task list](examples/tasks.rs): list plus on-disk SQLite
- [Crate rustdoc](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/): Boot,
  tokens, Action, `native_dialog`, `theme::named`, `theme::follow`
- Heading jump: `MarkdownDoc::item_offset` then
  `icedtea::iced::widget::operation::scroll_to` with
  `AbsoluteOffset { x: None, y: Some(y) }`
- A path crate should copy this repo's `Cargo.lock` so a fresh
  resolve stays on rustc 1.89
- Keys: set `KeyContext.modal_open` when a palette or menu is open
  so Escape and arrows stay on that layer
- Open a row's rustdoc for the signature, `*Opts`, `*Face`, and the
  compiling example. The one-line job is not the full call
- Native file open/save is `icedtea::native_dialog` + `DialogSpec`
  (crate rustdoc host). Catalog `dialogs` is the in-window sheet
- Palette: keep `CommandPalette` in the app; paint it in an iced
  `stack` over the window
- A path crate next to this repo needs an empty `[workspace]`
  table so Cargo does not treat it as a member

## [Controls](controls.md)

- [button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.button.html): Press a labeled control to send a message. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [toggle-icon-button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.icon_button_toggle.html): Icon button that stays pressed while on. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [slider](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.slider.html): Pick a number on a range. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [button-group](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.button_group.html): Related actions in one strip (M3 button group). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [segmented-button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.segmented_button.html): Exclusive choice among labeled segments (M3 segmented button). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [checkbox](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.checkbox.html): Check, clear, or mark a partial selection. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [radio](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.radio.html): Pick one value from a small set. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [switch](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.switch.html): A sliding on/off control. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [range-slider](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.range_slider.html): Inclusive low/high pair on one range (M3 range slider as two linked thumbs). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [icon-button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.icon_button.html): Icon-only press control (toolbar density). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [split-button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.split_button.html): A primary press plus a more menu. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [toggle-button](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.toggle_button.html): A button that stays pressed while on. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)

## [Fields](fields.md)

- [search](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.search_input.html): A query field: one Search-radius bar with the glass inside. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [search-view](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.search_view.html): Docked search results under a search field (M3 search view, desktop). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [text-input](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.text_input.html): Single-line field. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [field-support](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.field_support.html): Field stack with optional supporting or error text under the control. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [password](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.password_input.html): A masked single-line editor. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [secret](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.secret_field.html): A settings row: masked field, reveal, and copy. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [value-field](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.value_field.html): A labeled read-only value the user can select and copy. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [textarea](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.textarea.html): Multiline editor. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [suggest](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.suggest_field.html): Text field plus a keyboard-complete pick list; the application owns the suggestion slice for the whole `view` (store it on the app; a local `Vec` cannot outlive the `Element`). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [select](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.pick_list.html): Pick one string from a list. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [form](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.form_group.html): Form group that owns Tab and Shift+Tab among mixed fields. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [number](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.number_input.html): Edit a numeric value with step buttons. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [date](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.date_stepper.html): Pick a calendar date. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [time](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.time_picker.html): Step hour, minute, second, or period on a 24-hour value. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)

- [chip](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.chip.html): A compact labeled pill. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [badge](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.badge.html): A count or status mark. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [card](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.group_box.html): A titled panel around children. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)

- [banner](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.banner.html): A page-level message with an optional action. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [command-bar](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.command_bar.html): The toolbar row, denser. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [context-menu](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.context_menu.html): Place a context menu at `origin` in the window. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [sectioned-menu](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.sectioned_menu.html): Vertical menu list with optional section titles and hairline dividers. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [cascade-menu](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.cascade_menu.html): Two-level cascade: primary list, optional open submenu panel. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [breadcrumb](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.breadcrumb.html): A path of links. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [menu](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.menu_bar.html): An in-window menu bar from one `ActionTable` (`crate::i18n::Catalog`, `on_open`). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [toolbar](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.toolbar.html): A row of action buttons from the same table as the menu. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [status-bar](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.status_bar.html): Footer text plus shortcut hints from the same table. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [busy](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.busy_overlay.html): Dim plus spinner over `child` when `busy`. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [toast](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.toast_view.html): A transient notice. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [scrollbar](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/widget/fn.scroll.html): A themed scroller with a usable handle. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/widget.rs)
- [motion](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/motion/fn.overlay.html): Fade and slide a child for overlay enter/exit. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/motion.rs)
- [switch-motion](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/motion/fn.switch.html): Replace `outgoing` with `incoming` from a 0..=1 progress. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/motion.rs)
- [attention-motion](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/motion/fn.attention.html): Shake or pulse a child from a 0..=1 progress. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/motion.rs)
- [expand-motion](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/motion/fn.expand.html): Clip a child between a peek size and its open size on one `Axis`. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/motion.rs)

## [Patterns](patterns.md)

- [side-sheet](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.side_sheet.html): Docked supporting pane (M3 side sheet) over a dimmed scene. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [dialogs](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.dialog_sheet.html): An in-window confirm / message / save sheet (`DialogOpts`). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [list-detail](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.list_detail.html): A sidebar list beside a filling detail pane. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [inspector](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.inspector.html): Master, detail, and a side inspector stay in one row. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [drawer](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.drawer.html): Compact-width side pane beside `content`. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [workspace](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.workspace.html): Nested dock tree: splits with a sash, tab groups, and leaf chrome. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [tool-panel](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.tool_panel.html): Title chrome plus a Dock control. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [nav-rail](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.nav_rail.html): Compact destination rail beside content (desktop map of M3 navigation rail). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [navigation](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.navigation_view.html): Sidebar beside content, or a stack with Back. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [tab-view](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.tab_view.html): Tabs plus a filling body. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [preferences](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.preferences_page.html): Searchable preference groups. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [about](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.about_page.html): Name, version, license, and credits. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [status-page](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.status_page.html): Centered empty or error state. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [palette](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.command_palette_view.html): Fuzzy find over the action table (`crate::palette::CommandPalette` results, `crate::palette::PaletteOpts`; stack over the window). [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
- [main-window](https://docs.rs/icedtea/latest/icedtea/pattern/fn.main_window.html): Menu, toolbar, center, and status docked together. [source](https://github.com/indynull/icedtea/blob/main/src/pattern.rs)
